reviewNotes: GPT-6 AI editorial review of 28 original low-typing adjective questions. Checked every completed German sentence, adjective inflection, each offered distractor, answer key, bilingual explanations and distinct contexts. Fourteen sources authored and six deferred due to CEFR/register uncertainty or elementary vocabulary. Flagged unrelated inherited dankbar music-title/translation and incorrect digital comparison metadata; inherited sentences not reused. Source levels unverified; structural CI does not establish independent editorial approval, rights clearance, CEFR certification or measured transfer. All targets pending, publicationApproved=false.
